premise.claim: GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 (critical): certifi < 2026.10.19 bundles emSign ECC Root CA - G3; eight eMudhra intermediate CAs chaining to it have compromised private keys. The mooncake e2e image pins certifi 2026.7.22, i.e. trusts the compromised root.
premise.evidence: results/p0-bundle-delta.txt — base pin 2026.7.22 bundle (121 certs) contains 'CN = emSign ECC Root CA - G3'; head pin 2026.10.19 bundle (120 certs) removes exactly that one cert; nothing else changed.

findings.claim: The certifi entry pins a version >= 2026.10.19 (GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 patched range), all listed hashes equal official PyPI artifact hashes, the py3-none-any wheel hash is present (load-bearing under --only-binary=:all:), and the pin satisfies every certifi constraint declared by the other pinned distributions.
pip accepts the shipped certifi entry under the Dockerfile's flags (--only-binary=:all: --require-hashes); mutated entries (corrupted hash, sdist-only hash, version/hash mismatch) are rejected.

liveNote: L3 intentionally skipped: the artifact is an e2e-only image; the integration evidence is the PR's own kind-e2e-test workflow (5/5 k8s versions green at e0f01cc), which builds this image with --require-hashes and runs the mooncake client-less topology e2e. See results/ci-status.txt.
